title: Cathedral of the Holy Name of Saint Virgin Mary
visualBrief: Individual Minsk Holy Name Cathedral: pale cream plaster/white pilaster Baroque twin-tower front, stacked tall arched fields and hollow upper belfry/attic tiers, dark gray curved metal caps and crosses; shaped central gable with figure niche and small lantern/cross. Projecting entrance with recessed vaulted wood portal, flanking windows, tall central arched glazing, white paired columns, triangular door surround and open balcony railing. Long dark gray nave roof, low aisles, rounded rear apse with geometric windows, two rear-side cupolas/finials and low mapped side ranges. Four existing shared plaster/limestone/standing-seam metal/wood graphs, linear tints, metric UVs, flat normals and four budgeted browser levels. Fine sculptural capitals/urns/statue detail/iron scrollwork/inscriptions, full interiors/bells, exact rear windows/roof joins and surveyed plaza/thresholds remain approximate or excluded.

nativeAxes.x: east/southeast from rounded rear apse toward twin-tower front and projecting entrance

Side/rear profiles and windows are inferred from detailed map controls and front architectural character. Fine sculptural capitals/urns/statue detail, text/iron scrollwork, full interior/bells, hidden roof joins and surveyed plaza/thresholds are approximate or excluded. The78 raw component controls include small overlapping decorative plans; their metadata is retained while fine details are simplified rather than mechanically extruded from ground. Physical laptop/phone timing pending.

Skyline keeps all major massing, tiered towers/caps, shaped gable/lantern, projecting entry, round apse and smaller rear cupolas. District adds shared textures, flat glazing, selected pilasters/urns and open balcony. Street adds real recesses and upper belfry voids, columns, figure niche and finer railing. Closeup/master refine capitals, window bars and nested surrounds. Synthetic cottages are review fixtures.
